findings.fact: All schema/name/per-part SHA+size/final whole SHA+size checks use assert. Static compilation optimize=1 removes every LOAD_ASSERTION_ERROR. With -O or inherited PYTHONOPTIMIZE=1, a transport manifest with wrong hashes can still reach success JSON after writing; output.open(xb) only retains exclusive create protection.
findings.evidence_kind: independent source/bytecode inspection; not an executed failure or retest
findings.required_change: Use explicit validation raising ValueError/SystemExit for manifest/name/part and whole checks (or reject optimized mode before any mkdir/write). Preserve xb exclusive-create; do not modify original archives.
findings.impact_scope: restore helper integrity enforcement; existing wrappers/parts independently verified good by this audit
